description: An eight step trigger sequencer where each step is switched on or off and fires with a probability of its own

params.text: Switches this step on or off, latching on each press; every step comes up off
Sets the chance that this step fires when the sequencer reaches it, 0 to 100 per cent, and it is read only while that step is switched on

inputs.text: Moves to the next step on each rising edge above 1V, wrapping round after the eighth
Sends the sequence back so the next clock plays the first step, and cuts short any pulse in progress

outputs.text: A 10V pulse 10ms long each time a step fires

notes: every step comes up switched off, so nothing is put out until you switch steps on and patch a clock to IN

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
unipolar · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
